# What crates/cli/tests/e2e.rs expects for this scenario. ok/fail: does
# the job run when every job before it passed, or failed. A step `if`
# shows A/B: runs while the job passes / runs after an earlier step failed.

convert: exit 0
validate: exit 0
event push-main (compile refs/heads/main)
  api: triggered
    job test on ubuntu-latest: ok=run fail=run
      step checkout
      step run: cargo test (in services/api)
      step run: ./scripts/check-openapi.sh services/api/openapi.yaml (in .)
  docs: not triggered
  web: not triggered
event push-feature (compile refs/heads/feature/login)
  api: not triggered
  docs: not triggered
  web: triggered
    job build on ubuntu-latest: ok=run fail=run
      step checkout
      step run: npm ci && npm run build (in web)
event push-tag (compile refs/tags/v1.4.0)
  api: not triggered
  docs: not triggered
  web: not triggered
event pull_request-opened (compile refs/heads/main)
  api: not triggered
  docs: triggered
    job preview on ubuntu-latest: ok=run fail=run
      if github.event.action != 'closed'
      step checkout
      step run: mdbook build docs
      step Publish the preview if github.event_name == 'pull_request': ok=run/skip fail=run/skip
    job cleanup on ubuntu-latest: ok=skip fail=skip
      if github.event.action == 'closed' && github.event.pull_request.merged
      step run: ./scripts/preview.sh --delete ${{ github.event.number }}
  web: triggered
    job build on ubuntu-latest: ok=run fail=run
      step checkout
      step run: npm ci && npm run build (in web)
event pull_request-synchronize (compile refs/heads/main)
  api: not triggered
  docs: triggered
    job preview on ubuntu-latest: ok=run fail=run
      if github.event.action != 'closed'
      step checkout
      step run: mdbook build docs
      step Publish the preview if github.event_name == 'pull_request': ok=run/skip fail=run/skip
    job cleanup on ubuntu-latest: ok=skip fail=skip
      if github.event.action == 'closed' && github.event.pull_request.merged
      step run: ./scripts/preview.sh --delete ${{ github.event.number }}
  web: triggered
    job build on ubuntu-latest: ok=run fail=run
      step checkout
      step run: npm ci && npm run build (in web)
event pull_request-closed (compile refs/heads/main)
  api: not triggered
  docs: triggered
    job preview on ubuntu-latest: ok=skip fail=skip
      if github.event.action != 'closed'
      step checkout
      step run: mdbook build docs
      step Publish the preview if github.event_name == 'pull_request': never reached
    job cleanup on ubuntu-latest: ok=run fail=run
      if github.event.action == 'closed' && github.event.pull_request.merged
      step run: ./scripts/preview.sh --delete ${{ github.event.number }}
  web: not triggered
event workflow_dispatch (compile refs/heads/main)
  api: not triggered
  docs: not triggered
  web: not triggered
